shortfall_reason: 13/20 distinct publishable concepts accepted from 15 submitted; shortfall 7 = five absent target concepts plus two rejected submitted records. All nine cited public primary bodies and all 45 submitted factual fields were compared, with 39 supported fields retained; rejected records are not accepted despite individually supported text because of example duplication or incorrect original-entry matching. No producer repairs, seed changes, media acquisition, performance viewing, measurements or rights grants occurred. Two accepted records enrich existing acting IDs; eleven are distinct metadata concepts. No padding to target and no claim of complete category population.
